dei.evidence: to achieve full representation of women and under-represented minorities at Intel by 2020

innovation.evidence: We believe technology must constantly evolve to make more things possible and all things easier, smarter, and more connected than ever before.

result.analyst_notes: Mostly site chrome: rankings, recruiting prompts and tracking scripts dominate. The substantive text is brief and aspirational, using first-person plural 'We believe' for innovation. The DEI commitment is the only concrete, quantified pledge, stated in absolute terms with a dollar figure and a 2020 target. Other stakeholders are absent.
